\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 254-257 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R262-first-pass-words-from-chapters-254-257}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an accident and stress.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to fry, to grill, to boil, to mix, to peel
  \item to be late, to visit, to phone, to get better, to examine
  \item to fail, to pass, to explain, to translate, to give back
  \item to refuse, to graduate, to be glad, to be afraid, to smile
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To fry? (\textbf{\ar{قلى}}, \emph{qalā}.) To grill? (\textbf{\ar{شوى}}, \emph{shawā}.) To boil? (\textbf{\ar{غلى}}, \emph{ghalā}.) To mix? (\textbf{\ar{خلط}}, \emph{khalaṭa}.) To peel? (\textbf{\ar{قشر}}, \emph{qashshara}.) To be late? (\textbf{\ar{تأخر}}, \emph{taʾakhkhara}.) To visit? (\textbf{\ar{زار}}, \emph{zāra}.) To phone? (\textbf{\ar{اتصل}}, \emph{ittaṣala}.) To get better? (\textbf{\ar{تحسن}}, \emph{taḥassana}.) To examine? (\textbf{\ar{فحص}}, \emph{faḥaṣa}.) To fail? (\textbf{\ar{رسب}}, \emph{rasaba}.) To pass? (\textbf{\ar{اجتاز}}, \emph{ijtāza}.) To explain? (\textbf{\ar{شرح}}, \emph{sharaḥa}.) To translate? (\textbf{\ar{ترجم}}, \emph{tarjama}.) To give back? (\textbf{\ar{أعاد}}, \emph{aʿāda}.) To refuse? (\textbf{\ar{رفض}}, \emph{rafaḍa}.) To graduate? (\textbf{\ar{تخرج}}, \emph{takharraja}.) To be glad? (\textbf{\ar{فرح}}, \emph{fariḥa}.) To be afraid? (\textbf{\ar{خاف}}, \emph{khāfa}.) To smile? (\textbf{\ar{ابتسم}}, \emph{ibtasama}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

To respect? (\textbf{\ar{احترم}}, \emph{iḥtarama}.) To forgive? (\textbf{\ar{سامح}}, \emph{sāmaḥa}.) To lie? (\textbf{\ar{كذب}}, \emph{kadhaba}.) To take part? (\textbf{\ar{شارك}}, \emph{shāraka}.) To disagree? (\textbf{\ar{اختلف}}, \emph{ikhtalafa}.) To publish? (\textbf{\ar{نشر}}, \emph{nashara}.) To broadcast? (\textbf{\ar{بث}}, \emph{baththa}.) To follow? (\textbf{\ar{تابع}}, \emph{tābaʿa}.) To jump? (\textbf{\ar{قفز}}, \emph{qafaza}.) To press? (\textbf{\ar{ضغط}}, \emph{ḍaghaṭa}.) To sprinkle? (\textbf{\ar{رش}}, \emph{rashsha}.) To knock? (\textbf{\ar{طرق}}, \emph{ṭaraqa}.) To stick? (\textbf{\ar{ألصق}}, \emph{alṣaqa}.) To stir? (\textbf{\ar{حرك}}, \emph{ḥarraka}.) To wrap? (\textbf{\ar{لف}}, \emph{laffa}.) To melt? (\textbf{\ar{وزع}}, \emph{wazzaʿa}.) An ambulance; first aid? (\textbf{\ar{إسعاف}}, \emph{isʿāf}.) Temperature? (\textbf{\ar{حرارة}}, \emph{ḥarāra}.) A bandage? (\textbf{\ar{ضمادة}}, \emph{ḍimāda}.)
